s.c: N.M. Sherif (1981) Nubia before Napata (−3100 to −750), ch.9 (General History of Africa II)

t: The temple of Soleb is built in about 1400 BCE (GHA2_CH4 p.144)

s.c: A.H. Zayed (with J. Dévisse) (1981) Egypt's relations with the rest of Africa, ch.4 (General History of Africa II)

t: The religious revolution of Amenophis IV (Akhenaten) causes upheaval in Egypt but does not disrupt peace in Nubia (GHA2_CH9 p.267)
الثورة الدينية لأمنحوتب الرابع (أخناتون) تُحدث اضطراباً في مصر لكنها لا تُخلّ بالسلم في النوبة (GHA2_CH9 p.267)

s.c: N.M. Sherif (1981) Nubia before Napata (−3100 to −750), ch.9 (General History of Africa II)
